test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Identify the sentence with correct spellings. **

options.text: Rahul was ashamed of biheving so badly.
Rahul was ashamed of bihaving so badly.
Rahul was ashamed of beehaving so badly.
Rahul was ashamed of behaving so badly.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Rahul was ashamed of behaving so badly."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"behaving."**
 
• The word** "behaving" **means to act in a particular way. (विशिष्‍ट (अच्‍छा या बुरा) आचरण करना, व्‍यवहार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** *He was **behaving**__ differently.*
 
 
 
• **"Biheving" **and **"bihaving" **are incorrect spellings.
 
• The correct verb form is **"behaving."**
 
• The sentence structure is also correct, with **"ashamed of behaving"** indicating Rahul's regret over his actions.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
